question: A dishonest shopkeeper promises to sell his goods at cost price. However, he uses a weight that actually weighs 37% less than what is written on it. Find his profit percentage.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In cases of dishonest weighing where goods are sold at cost price:

Profit % = [Error ÷ (True Value − Error)] × 100

Here, Error = 37% and True Value = 100%

Profit % = [37 ÷ (100 − 37)] × 100 = (37 ÷ 63) × 100

Profit % = 3700 ÷ 63 = 58 ⁴⁶/₆₃%

**∴ The correct answer is 58 ⁴⁶/₆₃%.**
